verses.english: Linked Discourses 1.31
4. The Host of a Hundred Felicities
Virtuous
So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā satullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṁ jetavanaṁ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: Then, late at night, several glorious deities of the host of a hundred felicities, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, went up to the Buddha, bowed, and stood to one side.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Standing to one side, one deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
things get better, not worse.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
wisdom is gained—but not from anyone else.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
you grieve not among the grieving.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
you shine among your relatives.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
sentient beings go to a good place.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
sentient beings live happily.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then another deity said to the Buddha,
“Sir, who has spoken well?”

verses.pali: “Sabbāsaṁ vo subhāsitaṁ pariyāyena, api ca mamapi suṇātha—
verses.english: “You’ve all spoken well in your own way. However, listen to me also:
Associate only with the virtuous!
Try to get close to the virtuous!
Understanding the true teaching of the good,
you’re released from all suffering.”
That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Attamanā tā devatāyo bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā tatthevantaradhāyiṁsūti.
verses.english: Then those deities, knowing that the teacher approved, bowed and respectfully circled the Buddha, keeping him on their right, before vanishing right there.
